verdict.rationale: 1Password's own support docs say its Apple Watch app lets you quickly look up one-time passwords, which directly covers reading codes from a smartwatch. Only first-party docs back this, with no detail on setup or offline behavior. Missing for 10: support for watches other than Apple Watch, detail on how codes are viewed or refreshed on the watch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: Use 1Password on your Apple Watch to quickly look up information: credit card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords
